title: 1:1 prep - Alejandro Mendez (AE) - 2026-06-25
content:
Context:
- 30m 1:1 with Alejandro (AE) to align on Atlas Financial account, renewal conversation, and next QBR prep.
- Account health: Mixed - product adoption strong in fraud-detection pipeline but latency complaints on long prompts; renewal due 2026-09-15.
- ARR: $420k annual contract (hosted + dedicated burst), expansion opportunity for private deployment and additional seats.

Goals for this 1:1:
- Sync on current account risks and blockers so we can proactively intervene.
- Agree go-to-customer plan for renewal and possible POC for Private deployment.
- Confirm ownership of action items and deadlines before next week.

Key talking points / notes to raise:
1) Adoption + technical blockers
   - Reminder: engineering reported increased 95p latency for sequences >2k tokens on hosted (ticket JIRA-CS-8721).
   - Ask Alejandro: has customer tiered traffic to shorter sequences? Are they able to use prefix caching we recommended?
   - Offer: propose a quick dedicated-burst test for the high-latency flows (2-week pilot) - talk numbers (expected p95 drop ~350ms).

2) Renewal status + negotiation posture
   - Renewal target: lock by 2026-08-15 to avoid discount creep.
   - Alejandro is leading commercial convos; check if procurement timeline shifted.
   - Playbook: aim for standard renewal + add-on for Private eval (3-6 month eval, capped usage). If procurement pushes, offer a 30-day extension but require a signed ECA.

3) Upsell opportunity: Private deployment POC
   - Business case: Atlas has regulatory concerns for EU data residency and some air-gapped flows. Private deployment addresses this; potential $120k ARR upside.
   - Risk: SE availability for on-prem POC in July - confirm SE calendar.

4) QBR prep and exec engagement
   - Need to pull usage deck, cost-savings analysis (Optimize recommendations), and p95 latency graph for last 90 days. I can assemble the deck but need Alejandro to secure exec time (30m).
   - Suggested owner: Alejandro to book, Samira to prepare slide pack by 07/02.

Questions for Alejandro:
- Where are we on the internal stakeholder approvals? Who is the procurement owner?
- Can you share the most recent engineering chat with Atlas about latency (link) so I can call out specifics in QBR?
- If they request on-prem timeline, do they expect GA-grade deployment or a lightweight POC?

Draft agenda for our next joint call with Atlas (30m):
- 5m: Quick recap (us and them)
- 8m: Latency findings + proposed dedicated-burst pilot
- 8m: Private deployment POC proposal (scope, timeline, cost)
- 5m: Commercial next steps + target dates
- 4m: Q&A / immediate blockers

Action items (owner - due):
- Samira: Build QBR slides (usage, p95 graphs, Optimize recommendations) - due 2026-07-02.
- Alejandro: Confirm exec time for QBR and share procurement contact email - due 2026-06-30.
- Alejandro: Send latest engineering thread and logs about latency to Samira (attach JIRA-CS-8721) - due 2026-06-27.
- Max Evans (SE): Check availability for Private POC in July and give rough resource estimate (1 SE, 2 weeks) - due 2026-06-29.
- Samira + Alejandro: Draft pilot success metrics for dedicated-burst test (p95 target, cost cap) - due 2026-06-28.

Risks / notes to monitor:
- If Atlas procurement insists on on-prem GA timelines, may push out renewal. Need contingency credit/extension guardrails.
- Engineering workaround (trimming context) is suboptimal; pushing dedicated-burst or KV cache improvements is likely better.

Follow-up: set 15m sync next week (preferred Tue/Wed AM) to confirm owners above.

Quick personal notes (to self):
- Keep language simple for execs: focus on uptime, latency, and cost-savings.
- Emphasize low-effort pilot: short time-boxed results to build momentum.
- Bring up Redwood Optimize recommendations as cost-savings win (should help soften ask for pilot budget).

References / links to include in deck and outreach:
- Confluence: Atlas-Financial-Q2-plan (see linked_artifacts)
- JIRA: JIRA-CS-8721 (latency)
